note: What a server sends to name the units a chain missile will strike in turn. The header names the missile.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many of the slots are used, 0 to 32; 0 or less leaves the targets the client holds as they are. A client sets no bound, and more than 32 has no defined effect.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit casting the missile. Where a client does not hold it, the client starts no missile, though a missile it already holds under the header's name still takes the targets.

fields.name: targets

items.name: target
items.note: A unit, in the order struck.

fields.note: Always 32 slots; those past count have no effect.

revisions.note: Where the client holds the caster, the caster takes the list, whether or not the client already holds the missile.
